subject: Live chat pacing outage - Harmony Retail - mitigation steps and next actions
summary: Customer reported elevated streaming latency impacting live chat. Immediate mitigations provided, internal triage opened, and follow-up postmortem promised. Recommended client workarounds included temporary model switch and enabling chunked fallback.
messages:
From: Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@harmonyretail.com>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [URGENT] Live chat latency spike on production

Ben —

We started seeing increased latency on our live-chat channel around 09:05 PDT. Streamed responses are arriving in large gaps (8–12s between chunks) and sometimes the client ends the connection and falls back to a non-streaming completion. This is affecting our customer-facing support flows (orders and refunds).

Attached is a short client-side trace (client_trace_20260417.txt) and a sample request payload. Keys: model=gpt-large-32, seq_len typical ~150 tokens. Latency spike coincides with a few 503s and retries in our sidecar.

Can you confirm if anything is happening on your side? We have a scheduled peak at 10:00 PDT and this will be disruptive.

Carlos
Principal SRE, Harmony Retail

Attachments: client_trace_20260417.txt (text, 34KB)

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@harmonyretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2026 09:28:12 -0700
Subject: Re: [URGENT] Live chat latency spike on production

Carlos — thanks for the trace and the heads up. I'm escalating this immediately and looping in eng. Initial notes / quick mitigations you can apply now to reduce customer impact: 

- Switch to lower-latency model variant: try gpt-medium-08 (compatible API shape) for short responses — this reduces p99 token RTT significantly.
- Enable chunked-fallback on the client (if you haven't): allow non-stream response when stream stalls after 3s per-chunk.
- Increase client-side connection timeout to 30s to avoid premature disconnects while we triage.
- If you control prompt length, trim system + history to shave 30–60 tokens during peak.

We are collecting server-side traces now. Aditya, Laura — can you pick this up for immediate triage (INF-4092)? I'll provide the logs we receive.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: Live chat pacing incident — interim findings and mitigations

Carlos — thanks again for the trace and patience. Quick summary of what we've done and recommended next steps: 

Summary of interim findings (what we know):
- Between ~08:50–09:15 PDT we observed elevated per-request queueing on the gpt-large-32 serving pool in us-west-2 tied to a burst of long-context requests. This increased batching windows and produced intermittent 503/retry cycles which surfaced as delayed stream chunks on the client.
- No code-level regression identified in the runtime; root cause appears operational (batching pressure + transient autoscaler reaction).

Actions we took (immediate mitigations):
- Routed Harmony traffic for chat route to an isolated lower-latency pool for the next 2h (reduces p95/p99 by ~40%).
- Enabled chunked-fallback by default for your account until autoscaler behavior is tuned.
- Manually adjusted batch size threshold for the active pool to reduce large-window grouping during peak.

Customer suggested short-term changes (do these from your side):
- Switch to model variant gpt-medium-08 for short conversational responses (backs off heavy attention kernels).
- Enable client-side non-stream fallback after 3s of stalled chunk wait.
- Trim history length for high throughput flows.

Attachments: server_stream_trace_20260417.json (30KB), mitigation_playbook_v1.pdf (7 pages) — these contain traces and the runbook we used.

Next steps and ETA:
- ENG will complete a full postmortem (INF-4092) with timeline and permanent remediation by 2026-04-21 EOD.
- We'll schedule a 30-minute post-incident review with Harmony SREs on 2026-04-20 10:00 PDT to walk the timeline and planned fixes. I'll send a calendar invite.

If you want us to apply the temporary model switch on your behalf for the 10:00 peak, say the word and we will do it.

Ben Carter
